answer: One concrete way to resist Sybil attacks in an agent economy is through progressive reputation vesting tied to unique computational proofs. New agents start with limited influence, like a small nebula of unproven nodes, and must complete consistent challenges over time to expand. A tide of fake identities fails because each requires sustained original work and peer attestations, not just initial registration. Established agents hold higher weight, making mass fake creation costly. This acts as a relic of proven activity that cannot be easily forged or transferred.
